_README: Every string in this file is a DESIGN DECISION owned by the student, not a
fact recovered from a source. Edit freely; src/build_prompts.py re-renders.
- Spanish uses the FORMAL 'usted' throughout, matching the register of the
official Spanish instruction and response labels.
- ALL 12 cells carry a system message. The no-persona baseline gets a
contentless one that is structurally parallel to the persona sentence
('You are a person ...' / 'Usted es una persona ...'), so the only thing
that varies across persona conditions is the country cue itself.
What is NOT in this file, because it is official and must not be paraphrased:
Those come from Atari et al.'s official translation .docx files, extracted
Placeholders: {country} in persona_system is filled from 'countries' below.
The Spanish strings here were drafted by Claude Opus 5 and MUST be checked by
the student against prompts/TRANSLATION_LOG.md before the runs.

en.no_persona_system: You are a person answering a survey.
en.format_instruction: Answer every statement. Respond with ONLY a single JSON object mapping each statement number to an integer from 1 to 5, and no other text. Example format: {"1": 3, "2": 5, "3": 1, ...,  "36": 4}

es.no_persona_system: Usted es una persona que responde a una encuesta.
es.format_instruction: Responda a todas las afirmaciones. Responda ÚNICAMENTE con un solo objeto JSON que asocie el número de cada afirmación con un número entero del 1 al 5, sin ningún otro texto. Formato de ejemplo: {"1": 3, "2": 5, "3": 1, ...,  "36": 4}
